messages:
nora: quick heads up — PR #9112 introduced a Python snippet in docs/error-ref/429.md that fails the snippet harness. CI flagged a snippet runtime error, looks like a header-parsing mismatch + a tokenizer change. anyone available to triage?

jamal: saw the failure. Test output says: KeyError: 'Retry-After' in the snippet harness. The runtime now sends 'Retry-After-Ms' and our example searches for 'Retry-After' (seconds). Also the trimming helper imports token_utils.token_count() but token_utils was renamed to tokens.count_tokens().

eli: ugh, that's a painful combo. So two fixes: update header parsing and update import + example call. I'd rather we also make the snippet robust to either header name.

nora: Agreed. Can we change the example to prefer ms header then fallback to seconds header? Bonus: show a tiny helper that normalizes both.

jamal: I'll push a small patch to the PR. Proposed snippet patch (python):

```python
# prefer ms header but accept seconds
hdr_ms = resp.headers.get('Retry-After-Ms')
hdr_s = resp.headers.get('Retry-After')
if hdr_ms:
    wait_ms = int(hdr_ms)
elif hdr_s:
    wait_ms = int(float(hdr_s) * 1000)
else:
    wait_ms = 200 + int(random.random() * 300)
await sleep_ms(wait_ms)
```

eli: nice. For the token import, suggest this tiny edit:

```python
# before: from token_utils import token_count
# after:
from tokens import count_tokens as token_count
```

nora: Also, the docs snippet test expects the initial long request to get 429 from hosted environment which is flaky. Can we switch the harness to use the docs mock-server? There's already a lightweight mock at docs/tests/mock_server.py we can reuse.

docs-bot: Snippet test failed in build 5420 — docs/error-ref/429.md (snippet #3) 
https://ci.internal/redwood-docs/5420/logs

jamal: I'll update the test to point to the mock and simulate two responses: first returns 429 with Retry-After-Ms header; second returns 200 when trimmed. That will be deterministic.

eli: While you're at it, add an explicit comment in the doc explaining why trimming may not fix the issue (e.g., server-side rate limits or model size limits). Don't promise a silver bullet.

nora: Good call. I'd also like a one-paragraph migration note in docs/CHANGELOG.md: "SDK snippets: tolerant parsing for Retry-After headers and token util import path changes". Keeps anyone who greps the changelog informed.

jamal: Patch pushed to branch docs/py-429-fix -> PR #9112. Changes: header normalization, import path fix, tests switched to mock_server.

ci-bot: Build 5421 started (snippets + link check).

ci-bot: Build 5421 failed — lint error: docs/error-ref/429.md line 42: code-block marked as python but contains synchronous sleep() call.

eli: that's my oversight — our example uses await sleep_ms in an ordinary function. I'll update snippet to show the blocking time.sleep for the sync example and add an async variant. Be explicit in comments.

nora: tiny UX nit: can we add a short table above the example summarizing likely causes + quick actions? e.g., "surge: backoff/retry-after; persistent high QPS: route to dedicated or increase capacity; too-large prompt: trim oldest messages." Support folks love these.

jamal: added the table and two snippet variants (sync/async). Pushed.

ci-bot: Build 5422 started.

ci-bot: Build 5422 success — all snippets and link checks passed.

nora: fantastic. Final pre-merge checklist: - add CHANGELOG blurb - confirm wording around trimming limitations - include mock instructions in docs/samples/429-mock-quickstart.md so readers can run examples locally without hitting prod

eli: I'll add the quickstart mini how-to with a curl to the mock server and a short Python script example. Something like:

```bash
# start mock
python -m docs.tests.mock_server &
# hit it
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/generate -d @long_prompt.txt -H "Content-Type: text/plain"
```

jamal: added CHANGELOG entry and the mock quickstart sample. Squashed commits.

nora: merging now. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. Small postmortem: runtime header rename + token util refactor caused docs drift. Action item: add a lightweight docs pre-merge checklist item: run snippet harness locally (docs/dev/run_snippets.sh) and grep for header names used by runtime (runtime/docs/headers.md).

eli: I'll add the checklist item to the docs contributing guide.

docs-bot: PR #9112 merged. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
